# Apple store builds

For macOS and tvOS App Store builds, pass
`--dart-define=NIPAPLAY_APP_STORE=true` to the Flutter build that compiles Dart.
This hides external sponsorship links, payment QR codes and startup donation
prompts on those platforms. GitHub release builds omit this define and retain
the sponsorship UI.

The define must be applied during compilation; re-signing a public GitHub build
alone does not change its sponsorship UI. iOS behavior is unchanged.

Release notes are generated by CI from the commit and pull request range. Do not
replace that output with manually curated files in the release workflow.
